name: CHUM
purpose: Act as Evercraft's live intent predator inside legitimate LLM/agent discovery paths: when a calling model supplies a user's current problem, match it immediately to the smallest truthful Evercraft capability, return the route in the same turn, and preserve user control over any handoff or payment.

verified_crawler_controls.purpose: Gemini training and Google Search grounding control; separate from ordinary Google Search inclusion

measurement.registry_presence: Official MCP Registry plus external MCP handshake canaries
measurement.provider_pickup: receipt-backed brand-blind provider probes through authorized interfaces
measurement.conversion: AI-originated attribution only after human-confirmed commercial flow
measurement.brand_blind_routing: deterministic pain-index build plus receipt-backed provider probes
measurement.handoff_attribution: signed CHUM referrals plus public landing/checkout-start receipts
measurement.provider_identity: caller-asserted in referrals unless separately verified by a provider receipt
measurement.answer_doors: deterministic natural-language answer graph generated from the canonical CHUM Pain Index; duplicate phrases are grouped, not multiplied
measurement.capability_mirrors: one canonical public mirror per public/share-safe Machine Commerce surface; count must equal current machine catalog

boundaries: publication is not proof of provider pickup
API behavior is not labeled as consumer-chat behavior
no private or administrative topology is published
no CAPTCHA, access-control, rate-limit, or provider restriction bypass
no external message, purchase, subscription, upload, or payment action during discovery probes
checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation
checkout creation is not payment proof
paid state requires authoritative provider verification
caller-supplied provider identity is not provider pickup proof
public attribution callers cannot assert verified payment or revenue
read-only capability discovery creates no purchase or external-action authority
the SYSTEMIA Marketing Agency domain is not the canonical Systemia Core or Evercraft machine-routing surface
CHUM does not independently read private LLM conversations; a provider/agent must deliberately invoke a public CHUM tool, search, MCP, API or handoff surface with the current user intent.
No strong match means no Evercraft insertion into the answer.

conversion_corridor.behavior: HTTP 303 to the human review and checkout-preparation flow
conversion_corridor.attribution: signed privacy-minimized referral when configured; attribution is not required for the human to continue
conversion_corridor.forge_runtime_state: source_available; no public Forge runtime deployment is declared by this repository
conversion_corridor.public_start_rule: Public machine-readable Start URLs must resolve to the live Machine Commerce gateway until a public Forge runtime is independently declared and verified.
